name: tileward
description: Tileward for AI coding tools: refuse off-policy prompts before the model sees them, and keep long conversations small by recalling only the relevant slice.

plugins.name: tileward-guard
plugins.description: Refuse off-policy prompts before the model sees them, using the policy bound to your Tileward API key.

plugins.name: tileward-context
plugins.description: Recall only the relevant slice of a long conversation instead of resending the whole transcript. Hosted MCP server, no local install.
